name: Live with Walkman

images.credit: MehranVB, CC BY-SA 3.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Body.Dimensions: 105 mm H , 56.5 mm W , 14 mm D

Platform.Operating system: Android 2.3.4 (Gingerbread) upgradeable up to Android 4.0.4 (Ice Cream Sandwich) unofficially upgradeable to Android 6.0.1 (Marshmallow) via Cyanogenmod 13.
Platform.CPU: Qualcomm MSM8255 1 GHz Scorpion (Snapdragon S2) (stable-overclockable up to 1.6 GHz via custom kernels)

Memory.Card slot: microSD, 2 GB included (expandable up to 32 GB)

Display.Display: 3.2 inch 320×480 px TFT LCD at 180 PPI, 16M Colors

Cameras.Rear camera: 5 MP 2592×1944 px, 8× digital zoom, Autofocus, Flash LED illumination, 720p video recording, Face recognition, Geo-tagging, Image stabilization, Smile detection, Touch focus, Video 720p

Connectivity.Connectivity: Bluetooth 2.1 with A2DP, microUSB 2.0, 3.5 mm audio jack (OMTP standard), Assisted GPS, Wi-Fi 802.11 b/g/n
